items.summary_en: A debt collector for insurance giant Suncorp used AI to harass an 81-year-old woman. The AI pushed her for months to pay a claim she was not responsible for. People have raised concerns about the company's culture.

items.raw_excerpt: Canal Flats in B.C.'s East Kootenay recorded usage of about 690 litres of water per person per day in 2025. The village says possible leaks, aging water mains and a lack of water meters make it hard to know where all of the water is going.
items.summary_en: Canal Flats, a small village in British Columbia's East Kootenay region, used about 690 litres of water per person per day in 2025. That is about twice the Canadian average. Officials think leaks, aging water pipes and a lack of water meters may be the cause.
items.summary_ko: 브리티시컬럼비아 동부 커트니 지역의 작은 마을 캐널플래츠는 2025년 하루 한 사람이 약 690리터의 물을 썼습니다. 이는 캐나다 평균의 약 두 배입니다. 관리자들은 누수와 오래된 수도관, 물 계량기 부족이 원인일 수 있다고 보고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A small B.C. village uses twice the Canadian average daily water, and officials don't know why
